error.playerNotFoundDesc: No account exactly matching “{name}” exists on the {realm} server.
error.clanNotFoundDesc: No clan with ID {query} exists on the {realm} server.
error.clanNotFoundCause: The clan may have been disbanded, or the ID may be wrong.
error.causeTypo: The nickname is misspelled, or the player renamed their account recently.
error.causeDeleted: The account has been deleted — by the player, or reclaimed after long inactivity.
error.causeRealm: The wrong server is selected — this query searched {realm}; try another server above.
error.seenBefore: This player was looked up successfully before, but can no longer be found — the account has most likely been deleted.
error.apiErrorDesc: The official API could not complete this lookup. Please try again later.
error.rateLimitHint: Too many requests in a short time — the official API is rate-limiting this network. Wait a moment and retry.
